scripts.dev:frontend: cd frontend && PORT=3000 BROWSER=none npm start
scripts.dev:backend: cd backend && (if [ -x .venv/bin/python ]; then .venv/bin/python -m uvicorn server:app --reload --port 8000; else python3 -m uvicorn server:app --reload --port 8000; fi)
scripts.install:all: cd frontend && npm install --legacy-peer-deps && cd ../backend && (if [ -x .venv/bin/pip ]; then .venv/bin/pip install -r requirements.txt; else pip install -r requirements.txt; fi)
